floors.name: The Old Palace and the Beach

interactables.name: Leyline Tube
pages: A gilded tube set into sandstone, warm to the touch and faintly violet. A brass plate: 'IMMIA BEACH ARRIVALS. SHAKE THE SAND OUT BEFORE BOARDING.'

interactables.name: Pim Sandwhistle
pages: Welcome to Joz! Pim Sandwhistle, Goolax leyline desk. Your away-day pass covers the ride: Goolax pays, because Goolax wants you SEEN here.
The ride home's free too. Same tube. Shake out your shoes first, or the tube spits sand at the next rider. It holds grudges.
Heritage Walk starts at the desk with Zahir. Seven plaques, one souvenir, and more gossip than a mall should legally hold.

pages.text: Marhaba, and welcome to the IMMIA BEACH MEGA MALL! Zahir Moonglaze, Goolax away-day host. Fancy the Heritage Walk? Seven brass plaques. Find them all and come back to me.
Plaque one is right here on my desk. The rest: the old gallery, the empty plinth, the canal bridge, the temple shop, GrapFrap's front window, and the Hall of Queens.
You found all seven! Ooh. Look at you. A true Jozzy now: sandy, nosy, a little sunburnt.
Here: your Heritage Walk pin. Gold-ish. Free with the walk. Wear it at the match and the locals will cheer you a little louder. A little.
Between us? Three years ago I couldn't have given this tour. Half the stops were crimes. Now they're plaques. That's Joz: give it a year or two and the crime gets a plaque.

stock.name: Heritage Walk Pin
stock.desc: A gold-ish enamel pin: a crown on a sandcastle. Free with the walk; Zahir trusts you did it.

stock.name: Dry Fest Paper Fan
stock.desc: Pleated, glittered, says 'DRY FEST: HYDRATE, QUEENS' on one side and 'WEIRDOS WELCOME' on the other.

stock.name: Immia Beach Postcard
stock.desc: The canal, the gold domes and a very small, very smug crab.

stock.name: Aura Fist Fan Sash
stock.desc: Satin, sequinned, purple-gold. 'I SAW THE FIST.' Locals wear it to everything now, even funerals.

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 1: Welcome to Joz
pages: PLAQUE 1. Joz began as a Quonian military engineering port, was left to rot for 125 years, and became the best place in Th'Tief to not be found.
Since then: monasteries, chancellors, sandstorms, a palace, and now... this mall. Joz has always been good at becoming something else.

interactables.name: Goolax Away-Day Poster
pages: GOOLAX PRESENTS: MALL BRAWL AWAY DAY! Week 2 host: IMMIA BEACH MEGA MALL. Arena: the CANAL THRONE HALL.
Small print: 'Goolax is not responsible for sunburn, sand, flash floods, or being read to filth by a queen.'

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 2: The Palace Gallery
pages: PLAQUE 2. This gallery was the palace's long hall. Chancellors walked it to the throne room. Shoppers now walk it to the food court. Most say that's an upgrade.
Look up: the ceiling saints were painted over with suns during the last regime. The suns are peeling. Nobody's decided what goes back.

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 3: The Empty Plinth
pages: PLAQUE 3. A marble plinth with chisel scars and two bronze feet still bolted on. Just the feet. Somebody has given them tiny painted toenails.
The plaque says only: 'Here stood the last Chancellor. He fell two years ago. The feet stay as a reminder: rulers end, Joz goes on.'

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 4: The Canal
pages: PLAQUE 4. The river runs right through the palace and the old throne hall. Most of the year it's a polite trickle you could step over.
Then the hills get rain you never see, and the riverbed fills in minutes. Locals call it 'the sudden guest'. Never sit in the riverbed. Ever.

interactables.name: Throne Hall Doors
pages: Gilded doors as tall as three trolls. A Goolax banner hangs across them: CANAL THRONE HALL. CLOSED FOR MATCH PREP. NO PEEKING.
You peek anyway, through the glass. Gold daises, a river cutting the hall in two, three great stone plinths. It smells of wet sand and polish.

2: The banner now reads: THANK YOU, COMPETITORS! Someone has drawn a little crown on it in lipstick. Someone else has drawn a tiny flood under the crown.

interactables.name: Throne Hall Doors
pages: Locked. A notice is pinned to the gold: 'Daises re-gilded for the match. Do NOT lick. We know who you are, Dennor.'

interactables.name: MALL BRAWL Standings
pages: Scores, standings, and who's on top. Updated after every match day. Someone has added a sequin to the Broad Squad's line.

interactables.name: The Dry Fountain
pages: An old palace fountain, dry for years. It's been planted with cactus, and someone has put a tiny wig on the biggest one.
A handwritten tag on the wig: 'Her name is Prickly Heat. Do not touch her. She's working.'

interactables.name: Auntie Noor Brightsalt
pages: Sit, sit, habibi. I've had this bench since it was a palace bench. They charged me rent for it once. I outlived the man who charged me.
My grandson says I gossip. I say I keep Joz's records. Without paper. For free.
brushoffs: Again? I'm resting my legs, not running a library.
You've had your news, dear. Go spend it.
Shoo, before I tell everyone what YOU said.

interactables.name: Kassim Dunebright (mall security)
pages: Mall security. Ten years I guarded this hall as a palace guard. Same hall, same boots, new hat. The hat is worse.
No running on the bridge. No swimming in the canal. No death drops on the marble. ...That last rule came in with Cael, and it's still the one I enforce most.

interactables.name: Tilly Sprocketwhim (tourist)
pages: Tilly Sprocketwhim, Gok'Gok Harbor! Here for the match. Did you see? Those streetlamps outside are OURS. Toggleton crystec. I'm weirdly proud.
Everyone here says 'habibi' and 'darling' in the same breath. I've been called both by a monk AND a drag queen today. Best holiday ever.

interactables.name: Rafi Tamberlane (age 9)
pages: Fans! Paper fans! Two copper! I fold them myself! This one's got a queen on it. This one's got a crab. The crab one's for boring people.
My big sister does drag now. She used to do it in the cellar. Now she does it on the BRIDGE. Mum cried. Good crying.

interactables.name: Wadi Wad
pages: A tangle of old festival ribbon, a sandal and a bottle cap, blinking up at you from beside the canal.
'Name's Wadi Wad. Born when the riverbed got used as a bin. When the sudden guest comes, I ride it all the way out to the sea. Whee. Then I walk back.'

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 5: Hollow Halo
pages: PLAQUE 5. The Alt Righteous have kept a shrine here since the palace was built. Their faith is old, strict and patient: they fast, they give things up.
They pray brow-down in the sand, so the Forgotten One feels them. The shrine shop still sells prayer sand by the scoop. It is just sand. It is very blessed sand.

interactables.name: Brother Ascetus Dunmere
pages: Peace, traveller. Hollow Halo. We sell what helps you need less: beads, prayer sand, plain bread. The best thing here is the empty shelf.
Magaeas was betrayed long ago and asks only to be remembered. We remember by going without. You'd be amazed what you can go without.
Some brothers left when Cael came in, two years back. I stayed. Faith that only works under one ruler isn't faith. It's a uniform.

stock.name: Prayer Beads (sandstone)
stock.desc: Thirty-three sandstone beads. Count them when you want something. Then don't get it.

stock.name: Scoop of Prayer Sand
stock.desc: It is sand. It is very blessed sand. Do not put it in your shoes on purpose.

stock.name: Holy Water (flask)
stock.desc: Drawn from the canal at dawn and blessed by three brothers who argued about it.

stock.name: Incense (Jozzy Prayer)
stock.desc: Smells of warm stone and dates. Burns slow.

stock.name: Plain Bread
stock.desc: No salt, no butter, no joy. Somehow delicious anyway.

stock.name: Healer's Kit
stock.desc: The monks patch up a lot of sunburnt pilgrims.

interactables.name: Sister Wrenna Quell
pages: Sister Wrenna. Novice. Please don't tell Brother Ascetus I hum show tunes while I sweep.
I've been to GrapFrap. Twice. To... pray for them. With my eyes open. In the front row.

interactables.name: Faded Temple Mural
pages: An old mural: a great sleeping face drawn in the sand of the desert, and tiny pilgrims kneeling on its brow, brows to the ground.
Painted underneath: 'WE KNEEL UPON THE FORGOTTEN ONE, AND THE FORGOTTEN ONE REMEMBERS US.' The face's eye is scratched out. Recently.

interactables.name: Marisol Quaywhisper
pages: Shady Beaches! Sun hats, shades, swimwear with pockets in places you'd never search. Not that anyone searches. Why would they.
Every Jozzy worth their blood learns how not to get caught. I just sell the outfit for it.

stock.name: Wide-Brimmed Sun Hat
stock.desc: Shades the face, the neck and most of a small friend.

stock.name: Very Dark Sunglasses
stock.desc: You can't see their eyes. They can't see much at all.

stock.name: Swimwear with Secret Pocket
stock.desc: One pocket. You'll never find it again either.

stock.name: Traveler's Clothes (linen)
stock.desc: Breathes in the heat; hides sand stains.

stock.name: Disguise Kit
stock.desc: Fake moustaches, tan powder and three spare noses. Jozzy classic.

stock.name: Joz Army Knife (souvenir)
stock.desc: The tourist one: a corkscrew, a tiny saw and a toothpick. The real ones aren't sold here.

interactables.name: Hand-Painted Sign
pages: 'SHOPLIFTERS WILL BE ADMIRED, THEN PROSECUTED.' Under it, smaller: 'Mostly admired.'

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 6: GrapFrap's Front Window
pages: PLAQUE 6. For years this window was painted black from the inside, and the shop sold 'theatrical supplies'. The queens came and went by the back door.
The spring Cael took power, they scraped the paint off with hairpins, in public, in full face. The scrapings are framed inside. Joz cried. Joz still cries.

interactables.name: Miss Sahara Sundae
pages: Welcome to GRAPFRAP DRAG EMPORIUM, darling. Wigs, heels, lashes, fans, and attitude, sold by the yard.
The Broad Squad? Our girls, honey. They work the floor here when they're not training. Right now they're in back, rehearsing. Don't knock. Betch bites.
We used to sell out of a cellar. Now we've got a front door and a window and a sign. I touch the sign every morning. Every single morning.

stock.name: Lace-Front Wig
stock.desc: Glossy, gravity-defying, and secured with enough pins to build a fence.

stock.name: Steel-Shank Heels
stock.desc: Six inches. Arena-rated by nobody. Walk like you mean it.

stock.name: Clacky Fan
stock.desc: Snaps open like a thunderclap. Fully non-magical; fully devastating.

stock.name: Feather Boa
stock.desc: Sheds. You will find feathers for a year.

stock.name: Costume Clothes
stock.desc: Sequinned, structured, quick-change ready.

stock.name: Disguise Kit (Glam Edition)
stock.desc: Contour, lashes, glue, glitter: a whole new face in twenty minutes.

stock.name: Perfume (Aura Fist No. 1)
stock.desc: Smells like jasmine, sweat and victory. Limited edition. Unlimited attitude.

interactables.name: Pashmina Pell
pages: Pashmina Pell, honey. Lashes and gossip, aisle two. Mostly gossip.
Spin for me. ...Mm. You'll do. A little blush and you'd go to the final.

interactables.name: Mirage Tenderloin
pages: Mirage Tenderloin, darling, eldest queen on the floor. I've had this shoe size since before you had a shoe.
Don't mind the hairpins in the window frame. Souvenirs. Every queen in Joz pulled one.

interactables.name: Rehearsal Studio Door
pages: A painted door: 'REHEARSAL. QUEENS ONLY. That means you, Betch.' Under it, in different lipstick: 'I KNOW, BETCH IS ME.'

interactables.name: The Studio's Back Wall
pages: Through the wall: '5, 6, 7, 8! FORMATION! Closer, girls, CLOSER, we're stronger in a clump!'
'Hold it... hold it... and if they break the line, we start again. NOBODY breaks the line!' A stomp. A fan snaps. Applause, from themselves.

hidden.hint: Muffled counting comes through the wall: 5, 6, 7, 8...

interactables.name: Ottoline Brack
pages: Glass Half Fool! Potions, tonics and things in bottles that may be potions. The labels are honest. The glass is Jozzy: blown from our own desert sand.
Half full? Half empty? Half fool, sweetie. Buy it and find out.

stock.name: Potion of Healing
stock.desc: Regain 2d4 + 2 HP. Tastes of dates.

stock.name: Antitoxin
stock.desc: Advantage on saves against poison for an hour. Popular before makeup-puff fights.

stock.name: Alchemist's Fire
stock.desc: Sticky, burning, rude.

stock.name: Sunburn Salve
stock.desc: Aloe and cactus. Soothes, smells like a greenhouse.

stock.name: Empty Desert-Glass Bottle
stock.desc: Faintly gold. Sand-blown in Joz.

interactables.name: Idris Glintmoor
pages: Breath Taking. Sapphires from the Castori Breath highlands, desert glass, adamantine trinkets. Joz sells the world its shine.
Hold it to the light. See the little flaw? That's how you know it's real. Fakes are perfect. Like people.

stock.name: Small Sapphire Chip
stock.desc: A blue flake from the Castori Breath mines.

stock.name: Desert-Glass Pendant
stock.desc: Sand melted to gold-green glass, on a leather cord.

stock.name: Adamantine Thimble
stock.desc: Absolutely indestructible. Absolutely a thimble.

stock.name: Magnifying Glass
stock.desc: Jozzy lens, flawless. The one perfect thing in here.

interactables.name: Bina Twizzlewick
pages: Twizzle Me This! Twizzlewood fruit: tastes like strawberry, smells like coconut, grows like a rumour.
Don't plant the stones. Twizzlewood drinks a field dry. That's why Sizzlewood's half desert now. Lovely fruit, though.

stock.name: Twizzlewood Fruit
stock.desc: Strawberry-coconut, purple-veined. Sticky.

stock.name: Dried Twizzle Strips (bag)
stock.desc: Chewy road snack. One day of rations, if you're brave.

stock.name: Rations (1 day)
stock.desc: Dates, flatbread, twizzle jam.

interactables.name: Heritage Walk, Plaque 7: The Hall of Queens
pages: PLAQUE 7. DRY FEST: Lor'Fida's yearly drag-and-weirdo convention. For years it ran far out in the desert, where the temple patrols didn't bother going.
It was at Dry Fest that a newcomer called AURA FIST first took a Lor'Fida stage. Joz's Chancellor. Same person. The poster's right there.

interactables.name: First-Night Poster
pages: A sun-bleached poster: 'DRY FEST. BRING WATER. BRING WIGS. BRING YOUR WEIRD.' A list of acts, one circled in gold: 'NEW! FROM THE TEMPLE, WITH LOVE: AURA FIST.'
Someone has written 'and now she runs the country, LOL' under it. Someone else has corrected 'she' to 'he'. A third hand wrote 'both, honey, it's drag'.

interactables.name: Portrait Wall
pages: Painted portraits of queens, some with their faces blurred out by the artist: the ones who still had day jobs under the old Chancellor.
Since the purge ended, one by one, people have come in and painted their own faces back in. Three blurs left.

interactables.name: The Queens' Wall
pages: A wall of gold paint pens and signatures: every queen and weirdo who has walked this hall since the purge ended. There's one blank tile, just your size.

prompt.ask: Sign the Queens' Wall: your drag (or weirdo) name, and your signature move.

interactables.after: A gold tile, signed by {who}: '{name}. Signature move: {description}' Someone has already drawn a crown on it.

interactables.name: Velour Ashby (docent)
pages: Welcome to the Hall of Queens! Velour Ashby, volunteer docent and part-time showgirl. Mostly showgirl.
The hall used to be the palace wardrobe. Robes for chancellors. Now it's robes for queens. Same sequins, more honest.

interactables.name: Behind the Queens' Portraits
pages: Behind the oldest portrait, a seam in the wall, and a draught that smells of old perfume and spilled juice.
Press the painted queen's beauty mark. The wall swings in.

hidden.hint: The oldest portrait's frame sways a little. A draught?

interactables.name: Back Through the Portrait
pages: You slip back through the wall into the Hall of Queens.

interactables.name: Mother Tamarind Vex
pages: Oh! A guest. Sit, sit. This was the Dry Room. Under the old Chancellor, this was the only stage in Joz.

pages.text: He purged drag. Raids, fines, beatings. So we performed in here, by one lamp, for twelve people. Juice only. Hence: the Dry Room.
Once a year we'd slip out to the desert for Dry Fest, where no patrol bothered. That's where I first saw a scared temple boy put on lashes and become Aura Fist.

pages: Now he's Chancellor and I'm a museum. I keep the lamp lit anyway. Old habits. Good habits.

2: Did you see the match? Darling, when I was young the only crowd we got was twelve people and a nervous goat. Look at us now.

interactables.name: The One Lamp
pages: An oil lamp with a red glass shade, still lit. Under it, scratched into the bar: twelve names, and 'WE WERE HERE WHEN IT WASN'T SAFE.'

interactables.name: Yasmin Coalbright (Whet)
pages: Whet! Grilled skewers, flatbread, sauce that's legally a weapon. Brawlers eat first. Brawlers eat MOST.

interactables.name: Whet Menu
pages: WHET: Immia Beach branch. Brawlers eat free on the Goolax meal plan. Wait at the counter for the special.

interactables.name: Hamid Frothwell (Clara's Brews)
pages: Clara's Brews, Joz branch. Mostly Jozzy Prayer here: no alcohol. The queens bring their own. I see nothing.
Nobody's met Clara here either. Rumour is she's a sandstorm.

interactables.name: Clara's Brews Menu
pages: CLARA'S BREWS: Immia Beach branch. Brawlers eat free on the Goolax meal plan. Wait at the counter for the special.

interactables.name: Blibbet Wobblesworth (Goo to Go)
pages: Goo to Go! Gelatine, jelly, and things that wobble. Shaped like a crown this week. Very topical. Very wobbly.

interactables.name: Goo to Go Menu
pages: GOO TO GO: Immia Beach branch. Brawlers eat free on the Goolax meal plan. Wait at the counter for the special.

interactables.name: Sanne Hotcoal (Furious Freja)
pages: FURIOUS FREJA. Spicy. No, spicier. The desert eats fire; so do we.

interactables.name: Furious Freja Menu
pages: FURIOUS FREJA: Immia Beach branch. Brawlers eat free on the Goolax meal plan. Wait at the counter for the special.

interactables.name: Tobiah Peelwright (Oh Banañons!)
pages: Oh Banañons! All the way from Banañon Town, via a very confused camel. Banañon split? Banañon split.

interactables.name: Oh Banañons! Menu
pages: OH BANAÑONS!: Immia Beach branch. Brawlers eat free on the Goolax meal plan. Wait at the counter for the special.

interactables.name: Hob Haggleworth (Market trader)
pages: Hob Haggleworth, Market man, here to cheer our Stalling. And to sell a few pans. Mostly the pans.
You eat this spicy stuff? Brave. In the Market we've a saying: 'never fight hungry, never haggle full.'

interactables.name: Greta Coinclatter (Market trader)
pages: Greta Coinclatter. I sell scales. Weighing scales, not lizard ones. People ask. People always ask.
Since Lor'Fida took the Market, prices are up and tempers are up. Only thing that's down is my patience.

interactables.name: Big Esmé Holloway
pages: Esmé. Big Esmé, to my friends, of which you are now one. Want a chip? Take a chip.
Did you see the Aura Fist parade? The whole canal was sequins. I cried into my lemonade. Then I drank it. Salty.

interactables.name: Samira Dunebake (Dune Buns)
pages: Dune Buns! Hot from a sand oven. Honey, sesame, or date. The date one's the best. I'm biased. I'm the date one.
Market folk keep asking my prices. Then sighing. Then buying. Everyone in Joz sighs, then buys.

stock.name: Honey Dune Bun
stock.desc: Sticky. Warm. Sand-oven crust.

stock.name: Date Dune Bun
stock.desc: The best one. Samira says so.

stock.name: Bag of Dune Buns (6)
stock.desc: Feeds a team, or one Kuso.

interactables.name: Nadim Saltcup (Jozzy Prayer Juice)
pages: Jozzy Prayer Juice! Non-alcoholic, as the faith wants. Lime, mint, rose, a pinch of salt. Tastes like being forgiven.
The monks used to be my best customers. Now it's the queens. They order it with a straw and an opinion.

stock.name: Jozzy Prayer (cup)
stock.desc: Lime, mint, rose, salt. Cold. Holy-ish.

stock.name: Jozzy Prayer (jug)
stock.desc: For the whole squad.

interactables.name: Old Hadra Wellspring (Oasis Is As Oasis Does)
pages: Oasis Is As Oasis Does. Fruit from the oases, off my wagon. I drove this wagon through three chancellors. The mule's on her fourth.
In my day you didn't say the name of a queen out loud in Joz. Now my grandkids sing them. Funny old world. Better, mind.

stock.name: Fresh Dates (bag)
stock.desc: Sticky, sweet, from the oases.

stock.name: Oasis Melon Slice
stock.desc: Cold from the wagon's ice box. Drips.

stock.name: Waterskin
stock.desc: Rule one in Joz: bring water.

interactables.name: Brannock Pennywhistle (Market cart)
pages: Pennywhistle's Pots, from the Market! I'm only here for the match, and the pots. And the match.
Stalling's my cousin's lot. Well, my cousin's cousin's stall's lot. In the Market, everyone's a cousin if it gets you a discount.

interactables.name: Leila Tamberlane (fan stall)
pages: Rafi's mum. He's selling fans inside, and I'm selling the ones he folded wrong. They're my favourites.
My eldest is a queen now. Out loud. On the bridge. I used to tell the neighbours she was 'in theatre'. Now I tell them she's in theatre AND fabulous.

interactables.name: Marlo Brine (lifeguard)
pages: Lifeguard. Swim between the flags. Don't swim in the canal. Don't swim in the canal. I say it twice because people need it twice.
The canal's a liar. Calm as a cat, then it comes down from the hills all at once. I've pulled tourists out of the throne hall.

interactables.name: Splorp
pages: A wobbly goo person on a surfboard, on the sand, not on the water. 'Practising. Sea's scary. Board's nice.'
'Saw a queen surf a death drop off the pier once. Nailed it. I'm aiming lower. I'm aiming at standing.'

interactables.name: Tomi Saltbridge (age 7)
pages: This is my sandcastle. It's the Chancellor's palace. That's the Chancellor. He's a shell. With lipstick.
When the tide comes it all goes away. That's okay. I just build a new one. Better.

interactables.name: Dariush Goldtan
pages: Shh. I'm tanning. I'm on my third coat. Of tan. Of oil. Of sand, frankly.
Everyone's so CHEERFUL these days. Parades, sequins. I came to the beach to be miserable in peace. It's impossible. I love it here.

interactables.name: Lifeguard Flags
pages: Red and yellow flags. A chalkboard: 'SEA: CALM. CANAL: DO NOT. SUN: YES. QUEENS: 3 SPOTTED, ALL FABULOUS.'

interactables.name: End of the Jetty
pages: A very small, very smug crab sits on the last plank, looking out to sea like it owns it. Maybe it does. This is Joz. Somebody owns everything.

lines: Next tube in... whenever you like.

2: Back for more? Joz grows on you. Like sand.

lines: Heritage Walk! Seven plaques! One pin!
Ask me about the empty plinth!
Mind the sand, mind the sun, mind the queens.
No death drops on the marble. Please.
Mm. Not bad. Not GOOD. Not bad.
The empty shelf is our best seller.
*hums a show tune, stops, sweeps harder*
The Hall of Queens is open!
I knew this bench when it was a palace bench.

lines.say: Kassim! You were a palace guard. Did the old Chancellor ever smile?
Once. At a sandstorm. I think he liked that it ruined a parade.
And now we have parades every week. Look at that. The sand lost.
Eleven! And one to a monk! He said it was for the heat. It had a queen on it.
Good boy. Faith and fashion, both keep you cool.
Hm. Pray quieter. And less in the key of GrapFrap.
Mirage, the girls want MORE hairspray for rehearsal.
More? Darling, they're holding formation with it. It's structural.
If they stand any closer they'll fuse. Then what, one big queen?
Then we'd finally win something. Hush, they'll hear.
Greta, eight copper for a bun. EIGHT. At home that's a whole lunch.
At home it USED to be. Ever since Lor'Fida took over, everything costs a cousin.
Then our Stalling win here and we eat for free. That's my plan.
Splorp. The surfboard goes IN the water.
Says you. Sand doesn't drown people.

lures: Psst. Sit by Auntie. I know things.
Habibi! You look like someone who wants news.

pages: Those GrapFrap queens never fight alone. Stand them close together and they're hard to hit, and they hit harder.
Split them up, I say. Same as my sons at dinner.
You know whose shop GrapFrap is? Cael's. The Chancellor's. 'Grap and Frap', his company. There's even one over in Banañon Town.
He ran it from Ban'ton when Joz wasn't safe for him. Diplomatic papers and a wig budget, my nephew says.

lures: Security sees everything. Security also talks, apparently.
Psst. Off the record.

pages: I guarded the old Chancellor ten years. Chard. His boy grew up in the temple wing: shaved head, prayer beads, very quiet.
That boy is Cael. Chard's own son. The man who banned drag raised the queen who runs Joz now. I still can't say it with a straight face.
Heard Hex Deluxxx got banned from the canal for a death drop off the bridge, mid-parade. Banned for life. Or for a week. Depends who's telling it.

lures: Can you keep a secret? It's a holy one.
Sister Wrenna has a rumour. Don't tell the brothers.

pages: The Alt Righteous pray to Magaeas, who was betrayed long ago, they say by Selune herself. We go without things so Magaeas isn't forgotten.
The old texts say Magaeas isn't gone. Just sleeping. Nearer than anyone thinks. Brother Ascetus says I read too much.
Cael was a novice here, like me. Brother Ascetus taught him to sweep. He still sends the shrine a crate of dates every Seluday. No note. Just dates.

lures: Come here, gorgeous, Auntie Pashmina's got TEA.
Psst. You want the tea or not?

pages: The girls' weapons? Cherryanne's fan cracks like a whip. Korq's nails are literally nails. Dupreemiana's powder puffs are... not just powder.
Hex kicks in steel heels, and Betch has chucks AND a breastplate that punches. You did not hear this from me. You heard it from my lashes.
The big finish? They each take a beat getting into formation, then they hit you all at once. More of them in line, the bigger it lands.
Knock one out of line and the whole number falls apart. Rude, but effective.

lures: Come closer, darling. My hearing's perfect; my whisper isn't.
Little one. A word.

pages: Under Chard, drag was a crime here. Raids, fines, worse. We sold 'theatre supplies' and painted the windows black.
There was a little room where we still performed. Someone ought to show you the Hall of Queens. Look behind the oldest portrait.

lures: Docent tip! Free! Ask me!
Ooh, I've got a fun fact. A REAL one.

pages: Dry Fest started as a dare: a drag night so far out in the desert the temple patrols couldn't be bothered to walk there.
Aura Fist's first night, he did the whole set in a monk's robe and then ripped it off. Gold underneath. People still talk about the rip.
GrapFrap is the Joz flagship of Grap and Frap, the Chancellor's own business. His first shop was in Ban'ton. He came home when it was safe.

lures: Market man knows things. Market man sells things. Today: things.
Psst. Free rumour with every pan. No pan needed.

pages: Our Stalling fight from behind their stalls. Every round more little hawkers pop out: one tap and they're down, but they keep coming.
Smash the stalls and the hawkers stop. Leave them alone and they'll nail the stalls back up. Hit the source.
Listen for the stall bell. Ding-ding: more hawkers on the way. Every Market kid knows that bell. Means 'customers' at home. Means trouble in a fight.

lures: Psst. Shady Beaches sells rumours too. First one's free.
Lean in. Hats are a great cover.

pages: Stalling WANT this one. Lor'Fida took the Market a while back and Joz prices went through the roof. Their stallholders still grumble about it.
Winning in Joz, on Lor'Fida's own floor? They'd frame that.

lures: Scales never lie. Neither do I. Mostly.
Greta's got news. Weighs about a pound.

pages: Stalling keep a spare stall folded up in a hat. Pull it out mid-fight. I've seen the hat. Haven't seen it work.

lures: Lifeguard tip. Free. Life-saving.
Hey. Come here. Safety talk.

pages: Match in the throne hall? Watch the riverbed. When the sudden guest comes it fills fast, and it doesn't care who's winning.
Get up high when you hear it rumble. The daises are high. That's all I'm saying.

lures: Ooh, fellow tourist! Swap rumours?
I heard something! I think it's true! I'm 60% sure!

pages: Did you know Lor'Fida and Toggleton are trade buddies now? Joz crystals and instructors go one way, our crystec comes the other. That's why the lamps.
